question: Using the 2018 5-Year American Community Survey (ACS) for median incomes at the census tract level and the 2020 Federal Election Commission (FEC) individual contributions dataset filtered for donors in New York, matched to census tract geographies via a ZIP code to census tract crosswalk, calculate and list the average political donation amount and the median income for each census tract located in Kings County (Brooklyn), New York.
sql:
SELECT 
    ac.geo_id as census_tract,
    ROUND(AVG(i.transaction_amt), 2) as avg_donation_amount,
    ac.median_income
FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` i
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` cw
    ON i.zip_code = cw.zip_code
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` ac
    ON cw.census_tract_geoid = ac.geo_id
WHERE i.state = 'NY'
    AND cw.census_tract_geoid LIKE '36047%'
GROUP BY ac.geo_id, ac.median_income
ORDER BY ac.geo_id
